one_month_reasoning: No Qualcomm earnings in the window: the supervisor's base rate (Q4 reported exactly 38 days after fiscal year-end in FY23-FY25; FY26 ended Sep 27) points to Wed Nov 4, after Oct 30, and I found nothing contradicting it. In-window items are second-order peer and macro reads: Samsung preliminary Q3 (early Oct), TSMC Q3 (mid-Oct), Apple FQ4 and Samsung/SK hynix results in late October (iPhone modem mix, memory pricing), and the Oct 28 FOMC. Estimate revisions are running ~9:1 negative for FY27 (source 22), a mild drag, while the ~9% two-day drop into Sep 30 argues for some reversal; they roughly offset. So I keep a near-symmetric lognormal centred at ~$184 with ~14% monthly sigma (a little below 54%/3.5 because no print falls in the window). Unchanged from round 1.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (FY28 non-GAAP EPS, the NTM at the horizon, $11.0 x 15.5x = $171, weight 0.6) and FCF yield (normalized FCF $10.0B / 1.06B diluted shares at the horizon = $9.43/share at 5.5% = $171, weight 0.4). Up from $165 after fixing the dilution and FCF errors the supervisor found; still ~7% below spot because FY27 revisions are running 9:1 negative and data-center revenue comes at lower gross margin plus warrant contra-revenue.

inputs_detail.derivation: Replaces the Zacks $10.84 (high end) used in round 1.

Consensus $10.20 less ~3.5%: 27 of 30 FY27 revisions in the last 30 days were cuts (source 22), Dec-qtr consensus $2.30 is already ~34% below last year's $3.50, and Apple product revenue is now guided below $2B with share 'materially below' 20%. Revision momentum usually carries on for another quarter or two.

FY27 $9.85 plus data center growing from ~$5B guided FY27 toward the $15B FY29 target (say ~$8B FY28) at a ~35% gross margin / low-20s operating margin after the 1.5-2pt QCT gross-margin drag (sources 21, 22, 23), about +$0.9; partial Android recovery and price increases add ~+$0.4; ~2% share shrink adds ~+$0.2; less the warrant contra-revenue (~$2B total warrant fair value spread over up to $60B of purchases, ~3% of Amazon revenue, ~-$0.1) and a further Apple product roll-off (~-$0.25). Net ~$11.0, below the supervisor's ~$11.5 because I start from a lower FY27 and haircut DC margins.

Non-GAAP P/E history is 12-17x in the handset era; stock is ~18x FY27 consensus today. I give a mid-to-upper value for the growing non-handset mix but discount because SBC is ~27% of non-GAAP EPS (~$3.4B/yr), estimates are still falling, and several brokers are bearish (JPM Neutral $140, Seaport Sell $100, a Sep-29 downgrade to Hold). Raised from 15x in round 1 because I now use the lower, correctly defined non-GAAP base.

inputs_detail.derivation: The $5.55B 'tax payments in excess of provision' line offsets the non-cash $5.7B valuation-allowance release (source 25) and is not added back; the $1.8B inventory build is the real one-off.

9M FCF $6.83B + $1.8B inventory add-back = $8.6B, annualized ~$11.5B at FY26 margins; FY27 QCT EBT margin guided to 23-25% and data-center mix dilutes gross margin, so I take the low end of the supervisor's $10-11B range, ~$10.0B. Pre-SBC.

1,069M Q3 diluted count + 17.8M Modular shares issued after quarter-end = ~1,087M; Amazon warrant net dilution on the treasury method ~0.5M now and at most ~3M fully vested; less ~7M/qtr of buybacks (~$1.4B/qtr) for four quarters = ~1.06B. Round 1's 1.08B overstated Amazon dilution by ~20M shares.
A2-rated, ~$10.8B net debt, 1.8% dividend; cash-flow semis trade at 5-6% FCF yields. Raised from 5% to 5.5% because this FCF is before ~$3.4B/yr SBC and FY27 earnings are falling.

bear.story: Memory crunch persists through 2027 and Android OEMs down-spec; Apple exits fully with the Sep-2027 iPhone; data center lands at $2-3B in FY27 with thin margins and few warrant tranches vest; QCT margins stay low-20s. FY28 EPS ~$9.3 at ~13.5x = ~$125.

base.story: FY27 EPS ~$9.85, a little below consensus, with the handset trough in mid-2027; data center roughly hits ~$5B but dilutes gross margin; auto/IoT keep growing. FY28 EPS ~$11.0 at ~16x = ~$176.

bull.story: Price increases restore QCT margins, Amazon tranches vest visibly and a second hyperscaler ramps, non-handset beats the plan; FY28 EPS ~$12.5 at ~20x = ~$250-255, retesting the 52-week high.

thesis_break_reason: Below the $121.99 52-week low, ~12x the corrected FY27 non-GAAP consensus of $10.2 and ~11x my FY28. Trading there would most likely mean FY28 earnings are heading to ~$9 or lower (data-center ramp slipping, no warrant tranches vesting, Android/memory slump deepening, QCT margin below 23%). I stay at $120 rather than the supervisor's $125 because at ~45-54% vol, $125 is only about 0.8 sigma below my ~$178 median, so it is still close to ordinary noise.

reasoning: Round 2, skeptic lane. Accepted supervisor corrections: FY27 non-GAAP consensus is $10.20 (not Zacks $10.84), so my round-1 '$10.2 skeptic' was really consensus; Amazon warrant net dilution is ~0.5-3M shares (not ~20M) and Modular issued 17.8M shares after Q3; 9M FCF includes a $1.8B inventory build, so normalized FCF is ~$10-11B. New skeptic evidence that moves numbers: FY27 revisions 27 down vs 3 up in 30 days (22), so I put FY27 at $9.85, ~3.5% below consensus; data-center silicon carries gross margins in the 30s-low 40s with a guided 1.5-2pt QCT GM drag (22, 23); warrant vesting is effectively contra-revenue of ~3% of Amazon purchases (my estimate from the 8-K terms, 19). Street bears: JPM Neutral $140, Seaport Sell $100 (Mar 2026), Sep-29 downgrade to Hold (3, 24, 2). Insider 10b5-1 sales and the SA downgrade I now treat as weak signals, as the supervisor says. Result: FY28 EPS $11.0 x 15.5x = $171; normalized FCF $9.43/share at 5.5% = $171; fair value $171 (from $165), still below the supervisor's $185 because I start from a lower FY27, haircut DC margins and apply a discount for SBC and falling estimates. Scenario mean ~$182 (125x0.28 + 176x0.47 + 255x0.25) plus ~2% dividend; median ~$178. Ladder: 85/15 mixture of lognormals with median $178 and log-sigma 0.42 / 0.75 (fatter tails for the binary data-center outcome and 54% realized vol), giving P(>= $184) ~47% (from 44.7%). Research was limited to ~5 extra queries; the BofA note was paywalled.
